faq: Will you change my original file?
No. We work on a copy and keep your original untouched. Every edit is recorded in a change log, so you can see exactly what moved and undo anything you disagree with.
How do you decide what counts as a duplicate?
We agree the matching rules with you first, for example same email or same name and postcode. Uncertain matches are listed for you to approve instead of being merged automatically.
Can you fill in missing values?
We can fill gaps from other columns in your own data when the rule is clear, such as country from postcode. We do not invent or buy data to fill gaps, and unclear gaps are listed for you.
What file types can you clean?
CSV, Excel and Google Sheets are the easiest. We can also clean exports from your store, CRM or email tool as long as you can download them as a table.
